refinements.name: 迪斯科恶魔
refinements.description: 装备者的异常精通提升90点；装备者[强化特殊技]或[普通攻击]造成以太属性伤害时，全队角色造成的伤害提升15%，持续40秒，最多叠加2层，同一招式内最多触发一次，重复触发时刷新持续时间，拥有2层效果时，装备者的异常精通额外提升60点，该效果全队唯一。
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 90. When the equipper's EX Special Attack or Basic Attack deals Ether DMG, all squad members' DMG dealt increases by 15% for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. This effect can trigger once per use of a skill and repeated triggers reset the duration. With 2 stacks, the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency increases by an additional 60. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

facts.text:
南宫羽的异常精通提升120点；
南宫羽的初始异常掌控大于110点时，每超过1点初始异常掌控会使自身的冲击力提升1点；
敌人处于失衡状态时，任意角色对其造成一次[异放]伤害、[紊乱]伤害、使其进入一次属性异常状态时会为其累计1层[颤音]；
同一敌人最多可被叠加4层[颤音]；
若[颤音]叠加到最大层数且敌人处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态下时或当敌人持有[颤音]并从失衡状态恢复时，所有[颤音]会被清除；
[颤音]被清除时，若敌人处于上述属性异常状态下，南宫羽会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为720%/360%/900%/63%/90%/36%，敌人身上每有1层[颤音]，该次[异放]的伤害比例额外提升25%，同一次失衡期间，若[颤音]已被清除，则敌人无法再被施加[颤音]；
南宫羽的[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]或[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]命中敌人时，会使自身的属性异常积蓄效率提升35%，造成的失衡值提升20%，使全队造成的伤害提升25%，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
处于接战状态时，南宫羽每秒回复3.8点[重拍]，队伍中任意角色使敌人进入属性异常状态会额外为南宫羽回复12点[重拍]，该效果每6秒最多触发一次；
南宫羽最多拥有100点[重拍]，进入战场时，初始拥有30点[重拍]。
facts.textEn:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 120.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of Vibrato.
If Vibrato reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, or if the enemy has Vibrato and recovers from being Stunned, all Vibrato stacks will be cleared.
When Vibrato is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 720%/360%/900%/63%/90%/36% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once Vibrato has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain Vibrato again.
When Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact or EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 35%, and her Daze dealt increases by 20%, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by 25% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 Downbeats/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 Downbeats. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 Downbeats, and starts with 30 Downbeats upon entering the battlefield.

facts.text: 队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态时，南宫羽获得2层[舞力全开]效果，最多拥有2层，持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，拥有[舞力全开]时，南宫羽发动[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]、[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]或[快速支援：救场技巧]且重击命中同时处于属性异常和失衡状态下的敌人时，会消耗1层[舞力全开]对满足条件的所有敌人触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并触发队伍中上一位角色的[快速支援]，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态，若该招式未能触发[极性紊乱]则不会消耗[舞力全开]，当南宫羽拥有[舞力全开]时，下一次换入前场将直接发动[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]第一段蓄力攻击且必定触发精准蓄力；
facts.textEn: When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of Dance Prowess, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With Dance Prowess, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love, Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, or Quick Assist: Emergency Save hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of Dance Prowess is consumed to trigger the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's Quick Assist. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Prowess will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has Dance Prowess, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, which will always trigger precise charging.

cinema.name: 慵懒的聚光灯
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]或[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]命中敌人时，使敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低18%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；进入战场时，南宫羽的[重拍]回复至最大值，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's Downbeat is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.

cinema.description: 每层[颤音]使[核心被动：天才偶像]中[异放]的伤害比例额外提升10%；[额外能力：天使队长]提供的失衡易伤倍率额外提升30%；操作中的角色[连携技]重击命中同时处于属性异常和失衡状态下的敌人时，会对敌人触发[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，敌人在同一失衡期间仅能触发一次该效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Each stack of Vibrato's additional Abloom DMG ratio increase from Core Passive: Prodigious Idol increases by an additional 10%. The Stun DMG Multiplier provided by Additional Ability: Angel Captain increases by an additional 30%. When the active character's Chain Attack heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once during the same Stun period.

cinema.name: 天使的妄想
cinema.description: 南宫羽攻击造成的失衡值提升50%；敌人不处于失衡状态时，任意角色对其造成一次[异放]伤害或[紊乱]伤害、使其进入一次属性异常状态时会为其累计1层[颤音：改]，被[强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意]或[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]重击命中时会累计1层[颤音：改]，被[终结技：流落星群]重击命中时会累计2层[颤音：改]；[颤音：改]最多累计4层，当敌人进入失衡状态时，[颤音：改]会被全部清除，[颤音：改]被清除时，若敌人处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态下，南宫羽会对目标造成一次[异放]伤害：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为800%/400%/1000%/70%/100%/40%，敌人身上每有1层[颤音：改]，该次[异放]的伤害比例额外提升25%；[颤音：改]与[颤音]无法相互叠加。
cinema.descriptionEn: Nangong Yu's attacks deal 50% more Daze. When the enemy is not Stunned, each time any character triggers Abloom DMG, Disorder DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on them, the enemy gains 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love or Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact, they gain 1 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. When hit by the heavy attack of Ultimate: Meteor Shower, they gain 2 stacks of Vibrato: Modified. Vibrato: Modified can stack up to 4 times. When the enemy becomes Stunned, all Vibrato: Modified stacks are cleared. When Vibrato: Modified is cleared, if the enemy is under an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of Abloom DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to 800%/400%/1,000%/70%/100%/40% of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of Vibrato: Modified on the enemy increases this Abloom DMG ratio by an additional 25%. Vibrato: Modified cannot stack with Vibrato.

basic.name: 普通攻击：流星舞步
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞
basic.description:
长按 【普通攻击键】 发动蓄力攻击，造成以太属性伤害，在恰当的时机松开按键，可以触发精准蓄力，使得招式造成的失衡值提升20%；
南宫羽至多可以发动三段攻击，第二段和第三段攻击各需要消耗50点[重拍]；
[连携技]、[终结技]和[强化特殊技]发动后，若[重拍]足够，长按 【普通攻击键】 可跳过第一段攻击，直接发动第二段和第三段攻击，且必定触发精准蓄力；
南宫羽为操作中的角色时，[连携技]、[终结技]和[强化特殊技]不会打断[普通攻击：可爱地雷飞天撞]的连段计数；
第一段攻击蓄力期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低60%；
第二段和第三段攻击蓄力期间拥有无敌效果；
第一段攻击冲刺阶段能够格挡敌人攻击，成功格挡则此次攻击也被视为精准蓄力攻击；
所有攻击发动期间均拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Hold [Basic Attack] to launch a charged attack, dealing Ether DMG. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 Downbeats.
After using a Chain Attack, Ultimate, or EX Special Attack, if enough Downbeats are available, hold [Basic Attack] to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, Chain Attacks, Ultimates, and EX Special Attacks do not interrupt the combo count of Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：回转流星
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速攻击，造成以太属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：有点沉重的爱意
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: The Weight of Love
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
挥动锤子发动攻击， 造成以太属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing Ether DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：相当沉重的爱意
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
挥动锤子发动攻击，造成以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：流落星群
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量以太属性伤害；
招式发动时，南宫羽会开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]，[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]生效期间，全队角色攻击力额外提升50点，持续30秒，南宫羽重复开启[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕·妄想重奏]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise again, the current Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：救场技巧
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成以太属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
